status: Design coverage baseline; implementation not verified

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Original commercial game, not a ROM modification, copied codebase or research-first source reconstruction.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Continue the architectural spirit of classic JRPGs through independent data-driven, statically analyzable systems.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Graphics/presentation draw on Chrono Trigger and Secret of Mana, with Final Fantasy IV/VI elements, without copying protected expression.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Simulation depth targets Dwarf Fortress scale or beyond in both individual adventure and fortress/settlement play.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Crafting, exploration and world manipulation target Terraria richness or beyond.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: A generated world supports a polished 60–80-hour adventure with bonus chapters, areas and paths.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Approximately twice the baseline horizon is a stretch opportunity; the world continues after the campaign.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Keep the whole ambitious vision; stage implementation without silently replacing it with a shallow prototype.

requirements.group: A1 — Product identity and experience
requirements.requirement: Study the named references: Crystal Project, Sea of Stars, Octopath Traveler 0, Elliot, Terraria, Stardew and descendants.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Worlds, history, locations and campaigns are procedurally generated from coherent rules, not one fixed campaign.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Persistent seeds support replaying the same baseline world and creating divergent play histories.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Provide practically unbounded spatial/frontier and combinatorial continuation beyond the polished region.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Balance large-world travel with JRPG density, ample survival/crafting space and usable building land.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Ships, airships and other travel should feel consequential rather than abrupt teleportation.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Support eon-scale prehistory/evolution, long civilization histories and live historical continuation.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Simulate celestial conditions, seasons, weather and environmental consequences.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Simulate monster ecosystems, habitats, resource relationships, migration and adaptation.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Species, cultures, empires and cities rise, change, fall and leave ruins or descendants.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Dragons, medusas, minotaurs, giants, orcs and new beings can be historical/social actors, not merely enemy types.

requirements.group: A2 — Procedural geography and history
requirements.requirement: Historical acts leave physical/social evidence, artifacts, provenance, lineages, dungeons and quests.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Characters are customizable in appearance, stats, traits, equipment, skills and powers.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Provide tabletop/D&D-like breadth through original combat, exploration, social, condition and resource mechanics.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Default UI abstracts deep mechanics while power players can learn actual traits, algorithms, formulas and values.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Introspection itself is a trainable/discoverable in-world capability.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Knowledge, observation and analysis can unlock new creation primitives and shared discoveries.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Skills and crafting progression are vast, interconnected and interdisciplinary, not isolated linear trees.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Support overlapping learning routes through practice, training, apprenticeship, study, discovery and historical travel.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Open-ended magic and powers compose from reusable effects with combat and noncombat applications.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Support cooperative/combination techniques, builds, equipment synergies and tactical party roles.

requirements.group: A3 — Actor depth, introspection and progression
requirements.requirement: Jobs include combat identities, professions, social offices and actual work in the world.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Making is integrated into player gameplay rather than only a detached editor.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Crafting uses materials, tools, knowledge, skill, environment and transformations.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Player-created items, abilities, mechanisms and discoveries extend the same systems used by developers.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Survival, shelter, food, water, fatigue, weather and preparation have meaningful but manageable roles.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Farming, fishing, foraging, cooking, husbandry, breeding and domestic life connect to ecology/economy.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Dungeoneering supports traps, secrets, locks, navigation, light, verticality, archaeology and logistics.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Players construct towns, fortresses, workshops, infrastructure and institutions.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Players construct and operate dungeons using real world rules and can share dungeon grammars.

requirements.group: A4 — Creation, survival, domestic play and exploration
requirements.requirement: Crafting/exploration capability unlocks further places, materials, ideas and build choices.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: NPC recruitment changes residence, party, work, society and relationships rather than only a menu.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: NPCs have tribal/clan affinities and aversions with culture and history.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: NPCs have filial/kinship, household, ancestry and dependent-family relationships.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: NPCs have political, ideological, factional, cultural and personal loyalties or aversions.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: NPCs have socioeconomic/class, professional and material interests, not a single approval value.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Recruitable companions, memorable major NPCs and villains require coherent personality and narrative arcs.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Dialogue, beliefs, rumors, secrets and knowledge connect to actual world state and social outcomes.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Quests can be resolved through supported alternative disciplines and react to changed world states.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Heroic adventuring is a complete legitimate play path, without mandatory mastery of all other careers.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Trading/mercantilism, shops, caravans, logistics and production are meaningful careers.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Coliseums, tournaments, competition, fame and player-built arenas participate in the world.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Court intrigue, diplomacy, politics, claims, institutions and succession are supported.

requirements.group: A5 — People, society, careers and narrative
requirements.requirement: Battles and wars connect individual actions, armies, supply, morale and territorial outcomes.

requirements.group: A6 — Time, planes and alternate worlds
requirements.requirement: Spatial portals, other planes and distant world locations are native traversal capabilities.

requirements.group: A6 — Time, planes and alternate worlds
requirements.requirement: Time travel to supported historical/future states participates in actual gameplay.

requirements.group: A6 — Time, planes and alternate worlds
requirements.requirement: Travel to alternate histories with diverged societies, places, people and artifacts is supported.

requirements.group: A6 — Time, planes and alternate worlds
requirements.requirement: Quests and puzzles can require temporal/planar progression, not just use it as optional lore.

requirements.group: A6 — Time, planes and alternate worlds
requirements.requirement: Item, material, skill and craft graphs can depend on lost eras, extinct life and alternate knowledge.

requirements.group: A6 — Time, planes and alternate worlds
requirements.requirement: Advanced creation can manipulate portals and supported temporal connections under server rules.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: Solo/local host, player-hosted co-op and dedicated persistent servers precede MMORPG scale.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: Players can continue, replay, export or fork persistent seeded worlds.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: Every major game/content domain has sanctioned first-class expansion surfaces; ordinary mod hacks are unnecessary.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: Official/base content and community expansions use the same supported package architecture.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: Packages, rules and plugin settings are customizable per server.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: World-gen rules, history, narrative grammars, art, music, UI and tools are package extension domains.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: In-game creations can become portable shared blueprints/definitions/packages where eligible.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: LLMs/AI are optional and pluggable per server, including parameter proposal and procedural evaluations.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: Contemporary AI assists implementation/creation/evaluation while the independent game remains playable without it.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: The architecture underpins later community, social discovery, distribution and MMORPG layers.

requirements.group: A7 — Hosting, expansions, AI and future platform
requirements.requirement: Deliver a full GDD/specification and an explicit handoff for Astra implementation analysis.

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Accepted AI decisions/content are recorded and replayed; seed alone is not an AI determinism claim.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: NPC knowledge and introspection are scoped independently from server truth and administrator access.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Timeline changes protect co-op state, use explicit branch policy and transaction-safe travel.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Adaptive simulation conserves identities/resources and avoids double counting visible and distant activity.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Graph and package composition have typed dependencies, bounded effects, ordering and test coverage.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Save/version compatibility, package upgrade/removal, backups and recovery are explicit lifecycle contracts.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Narrative, world and host clocks have disclosed pause/deadline policies rather than contradictory urgency.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Quality claims are measured targets; unsupported seed/configuration combinations are labeled rather than guaranteed.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: Access, disability accommodations and essential feedback are not locked behind character progression.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open

requirements.group: A8 — Derived safeguards needed to fulfill the vision
requirements.requirement: World geometry, combat mode, headcount, hardware and technical stack remain explicit decisions, not owner-approved guesses.
requirements.source: Derived design safeguard; proposal details remain open
